Oilseeds.operating_rule: Primary ML inference (Random Forest). Fallback to Historical District Mean if district history < 5 observations.
Oilseeds.strategy_explanation: This forecast uses the certified Oilseeds Historical ML (RandomForestRegressor) strategy. The strategy was selected because it demonstrated statistically significant improvement (+10.8% vs baseline) and 75% fold win rate across walk-forward validation.

Chickpea.operating_rule: Direct Historical District Mean baseline with 3-Year Rolling Mean fallback for sparse district regimes.
Chickpea.strategy_explanation: This crop is served using a certified statistical baseline (Historical District Mean / Persistence) because evaluated ML models did not produce statistically significant improvement over historical baseline averages during temporal walk-forward validation.
